purpose: Production render-composition, layering, transition, and accessibility contract for Dallas realistic 3D chibis in NFL Gamecast. Metadata-only: no shared NFL runtime or MLB/NHL behavior is modified.

composition.coordinateSpace: Gamecast field-local normalized coordinates resolved by the NFL scene before chibi placement
composition.footAnchor: bottom-center between planted feet is the only player-to-field placement anchor
composition.scaleRule: Use the player-specific locked scale from Dallas appearance/base specifications; perspective may affect scene projection but must not mutate identity proportions.
composition.alphaRule: All chibi frames remain transparent-alpha assets; no baked field, crowd, halo rectangle, matte fringe, or team-logo backdrop.
composition.shadowRule: Runtime shadow/contact treatment is scene-owned and subtle; never bake opaque shadows into transparent source assets.

orientation.default: Preserve the approved shared three-quarter Gamecast camera presentation.
orientation.mirrorEligibility: Only action metadata explicitly marked mirror-safe may be horizontally mirrored for field direction.
orientation.numberGuard: Never mirror rasterized jersey numerals, wordmarks, helmet marks, or asymmetric identity details into an incorrect orientation; use an authored opposite-facing asset when mirroring would corrupt them.
orientation.ballHandGuard: Ball hand, throwing arm, catching geometry, and contact side must remain semantically correct after orientation resolution.

transitionPolicy.baseToAction: Blend from the current anchored base/idle state at an event boundary without teleporting the planted-foot anchor.
transitionPolicy.actionToAction: Prefer authored compatible transition points; otherwise settle through the shortest neutral anchored pose before the next action.
transitionPolicy.actionToBase: Return to the same player-specific anchor and scale after the action completes.
transitionPolicy.signatureEntry: Verified signatures may begin only from their declared event-compatible entry state.
transitionPolicy.signatureExit: Verified signatures settle back to the canonical anchor before another play-owned animation begins.
transitionPolicy.pollingRule: A repeated event fingerprint never restarts or re-times an active transition.

footballContinuity.singleAuthority: Exactly one visible football authority exists during a possession animation: scene ball or chibi-attached ball, never both.
footballContinuity.handoff: Transfer ball authority only at authored possession/contact boundaries.
footballContinuity.pass: Release the chibi-attached football at the authored throw-release marker before scene flight takes authority.
footballContinuity.catch: Scene flight yields to the receiver-attached ball at the authored secure-catch marker.
footballContinuity.fumble: Player-attached authority ends at the authored loose-ball marker; scene ball then owns motion until recovery.
footballContinuity.recovery: Recovery transfers scene-ball authority to the recovering player's authored possession marker.

collisionAndOcclusion.contact: Use authored contact markers and participant roles from roster-authoritative actions; do not stretch, slide, or rescale a chibi to force contact.
collisionAndOcclusion.multiPlayer: Resolve each player's foot anchor independently, then use scene depth for natural overlap.
collisionAndOcclusion.labelOcclusion: Player labels and critical score/down UI remain above chibis; chibis must not become an input-blocking overlay.
collisionAndOcclusion.edgeSafety: If an animation would clip the Gamecast viewport, adjust scene framing/field-local placement within allowed bounds rather than deforming the asset.

rules: Use only the verified historical sequence metadata.
Preserve Lamb identity/number/scale and bottom-center anchor.
Do not relabel or extend the sequence into an invented named celebration.
Use only the verified DeSoto Shuffle sequence metadata.
Keep root motion within the authored signature envelope and settle to the canonical anchor.
Do not substitute an invented dance name or unrelated celebration.

reducedMotion.behavior: When Gamecast reduced-motion mode is active, render the event's most informative authored key pose at the canonical anchor instead of playing the full motion sequence.
reducedMotion.signatures: Verified signatures reduce to a representative authored pose without repeated dance/gesture loops.
reducedMotion.continuity: Possession state, football authority, uniform number, identity, scale, and event meaning remain intact.

fallbacks.missingAction: Keep the player's decoded base asset and existing non-chibi Gamecast event presentation; never show a broken-image placeholder.
fallbacks.missingBase: Retain existing non-chibi Gamecast presentation for that participant.
fallbacks.decodeFailure: Memoize according to gamecast-integration-03 and continue the safe fallback chain.
fallbacks.signatureFailure: Fall back to the roster-authorized generic event action; never invent or approximate a named signature.

appearanceAndGeometryInvariants.appearanceAuthority: current official Dallas player headshot lock; skin tone and visible appearance are never inferred from name
appearanceAndGeometryInvariants.identityContinuity: Base, action, reduced-motion pose, and verified signature must depict the same locked player identity.

checks: Composition preserves transparent alpha, locked camera/lighting/scale, and bottom-center foot anchors.
Orientation cannot reverse jersey numbers or asymmetric identity details.
Possession animations maintain exactly one visible football authority.
Transitions do not restart on repeated polling or teleport anchors.
Reduced-motion behavior preserves event meaning and player identity.
Named signatures remain limited to verified Dallas concepts already recorded in signature metadata.
Fallbacks fail soft and never create broken-image UI.
Layering cannot obscure critical Gamecast UI or intercept unrelated input.
Contract is Dallas/NFL namespaced and cannot mutate MLB/NHL renderers.
This batch is metadata-only and introduces no unrelated runtime behavior change.
